frontmatter.description: Actual degree and term-register access, normalization padding, OAA and complete-trial evidence without exponential word enumeration.

children.value: . A quantum word register supplies those choices coherently: prepare the degree once, prepare one independent term register for each possible slot, and activate only the slots selected by the degree. This page implements that construction rather than constructing the full word list

Structured PREPARE/SELECT, signed Pauli words, all uncomputation, complete measured/reset trials and integer-round oblivious amplification are implemented. A separate normalization-2 zero-LCU padding circuit is implemented and checked. The
supplies 16 ideal-access contracts, 15 materialized circuits and six tiny numerical checks. A separate

supplies actual Clifford+T sequences and conditional physical projections. Wider-workload physical estimates, certified floating-point and synthesis errors, executed finite-shot sampling and formal verification remain unavailable. Nearly unit acceptance in a small instance does not establish deterministic evolution.

checks = []

for steps in (1, 2, 4):
    access = wt.build_word_taylor(terms, time=1/steps, degree=3)
    variants = [(0, False), (1, False)]
    if access.normalization <= 2:
        variants.append((1, True))
    for rounds, padded in variants:

        assert result["actual_source_block_error_vs_matrix_taylor"] < 1e-10

to preserve the whole coherent source on arbitrary register input. This matters when an access is inverted or coherently reused. Tests retain global phases and compare source/primitive matrices on tiny circuits and full-register statevectors on the ten/twelve-wire examples. Complete measured/reset instruments are also checked directly, including the acceptance bits and final unconditioned data readout. These are executable checks; no formal proof is integrated.

The pinned Qiskit exporter omits the circuit’s overall phase. The ledgers record each omitted phase. The measured-trial QASM preserves these supplied trial probabilities; coherent controlled reuse needs the source circuit or explicit restoration of that phase

The complete source, routed and synthesized gate-readout laws include every failed outcome. Output-bit maps are restored before comparison, and the final native or amplified accepted block is checked directly. The operator comparison concerns the coherent body

The source generator limits systems to 32 wires, terms to 64, degree to 8, total width to 96, SELECT predicates to 4,096 and source instructions to 100,000. Projected statevector checks stop at twelve total wires and six system wires; full Operator tests use at most eight total wires. These limits are independent of circuit-only materialization.

The accuracy-preserving planner separately caps systems at six spins, segments at 32 and degree at eight; its numerical workload checks stop at twelve total wires and three system spins.
